limitations: No actual participant run, measured cost, semantic equivalence, independent review or formal benchmark result exists in this source change.
Local packet projection does not provide filesystem, Git, network, history/context or tool isolation.
All selected reference/test entities are draft; public case language may leak knowledge.
Catalog completeness is non-uniform and part-level criteria may be unavailable to an ordinary participant by design.
Study analysis validates records/citations/accounting, not semantic truth, natural-language extraction completeness or external independence.
